description: Implementation of the ConfiguredProxyResolutionService class and related proxy resolver factory classes, managing proxy configuration, PAC script fetching, and periodic polling for proxy configuration changes within the Chromium network stack.

classes.name: ConfiguredProxyResolutionService::InitProxyResolver
classes.description: Encapsulates the asynchronous initialization of the proxy resolver, including PAC file decision and resolver creation.

classes.name: ConfiguredProxyResolutionService::PacFileDeciderPoller
classes.description: Manages periodic background polling to detect changes in PAC scripts or proxy configurations.

classes.name: ConfiguredProxyResolutionService
classes.description: Main class managing proxy configuration, PAC script fetching, resolver initialization, and request handling.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins initializing the proxy resolver with PAC file fetching and decider.

methods.name: StartSkipDecider
methods.description: Initializes proxy resolver using pre-decided configuration, skipping PAC file decision.

methods.name: effective_config
methods.description: Returns the proxy configuration selected by the PAC file decider.

methods.name: script_data
methods.description: Returns the PAC script data used for proxy resolution.

methods.name: GetLoadState
methods.description: Returns current load state of the proxy resolution process.

methods.name: OnShutdown
methods.description: Handles cleanup on shutdown, cancelling ongoing requests.

methods.name: ResolveProxy
methods.description: Resolves the proxy for a given URL, possibly asynchronously.

methods.name: TryToCompleteSynchronously
methods.description: Attempts to complete proxy resolution synchronously if possible.

methods.name: OnProxyConfigChanged
methods.description: Handles updates to proxy configuration from the config service.

methods.name: InitializeUsingLastFetchedConfig
methods.description: Starts proxy resolver initialization based on the last fetched config.

methods.name: InitializeUsingDecidedConfig
methods.description: Starts proxy resolver initialization using a specific decider result and script data.

methods.name: OnIPAddressChanged
methods.description: Handles network IP address changes, delaying PAC re-evaluation.

methods.name: OnDNSChanged
methods.description: Handles DNS changes, triggering PAC script lazy polling.
